blocking_variables.detail: requires the upstream decision table to have already selected a branch of its own -- not inlined (scope boundary: a decision table's output depends on which of its own rules fires, which is not a single closed-form expression to substitute the way a literal-expression decision's formula is)

Checked directly against Flex1.sql (2026-09-11): SEMESTER has only SEM_ID/TITLE/STATUS, and no D_* dimension table exists for semester type anywhere in the 220-table schema (every other coded category in this schema -- course type, employee type, student status -- has one). No dedicated Regular/Summer column exists; TITLE (free-text, e.g. 'Summer 2021') is the only candidate, and only via a fragile LIKE '%Summer%' substring match, not a clean equality lookup. A genuine schema-representability finding (§4.4-style), not an under-investigated mapping.
